'''Fadith-Ki''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Voss (species)|Voss]] [[Voss commandos|commando]] living on [[Voss]]. During the [[Galactic War]] he asked an outsider to destroy the [[Gormak/Legends|Gormak]] [[Gormak cannon]]s threatening the shuttle path to the [[Shrine of Healing]].<ref name="TOR" />
